title: Shadows Across Tehran
premise: Intelligence operative James Smith travels to Iran to intercept a courier connected to the extremist organization Dust of Allah. As he navigates surveillance-heavy streets and shifting allegiances, he discovers the courier may hold information capable of preventing a catastrophic international incident.
logline: A veteran intelligence operative races through a web of deception to obtain critical intelligence from a mysterious courier before violent extremists can act.

visualTone.lightingPhilosophy: Naturalistic espionage realism with motivated practical lighting, deep contrast, and atmospheric shadows

sets.name: Crowded Bazaar Passage
sets.description: A dense marketplace of narrow corridors, layered textiles, stone facades, aging signage, and tightly packed storefronts.
sets.atmosphere: Busy pedestrian traffic, warm air, dust haze, and distant vehicle noise.
sets.lighting: Filtered sunlight through fabric canopies mixed with practical shop lights.

sets.name: Rooftop Observation Point
sets.description: A weathered rooftop overlooking a sprawling cityscape with satellite dishes and concrete structures.
sets.atmosphere: Dry breeze, distant traffic, and a constant sense of surveillance.
sets.lighting: Late-afternoon golden light with long shadows and reflective urban highlights.

sets.name: Underground Transit Platform
sets.description: A utilitarian transit station with tiled walls, concrete pillars, and sparse architectural decoration.
sets.atmosphere: Echoing footsteps, train vibrations, and intermittent announcements.
sets.lighting: Cool fluorescent fixtures creating hard shadows and muted color rendition.

characters.name: James Smith
characters.physicalDescription: Early 40s, weathered features, athletic build, short dark hair, focused eyes, subtle facial scars.
characters.behavioralTraits: Observant, disciplined, economical movement, constantly evaluates surroundings.

characters.name: Nadia Farzan
characters.physicalDescription: Mid-30s, sharp features, dark eyes, composed posture, understated appearance.
characters.behavioralTraits: Cautious, intelligent, reserved, rarely reveals emotion.

costumes.name: Field Operative Attire
costumes.description: Practical civilian clothing designed to blend into urban environments with concealed equipment.
costumes.materials: Cotton blend jacket, durable trousers, leather accessories.
costumes.wearCondition: Light travel wear and minor dust accumulation.

costumes.name: Courier Disguise
costumes.description: Modest travel clothing with layered garments intended to avoid attention.
costumes.materials: Light woven fabrics, weathered leather satchel, practical footwear.

props.name: Encrypted Data Drive
props.description: Small metallic storage device with protective casing and authentication markings.
props.narrativeSignificance: Contains intelligence that could reveal planned extremist activity.

props.name: Secure Communicator
props.description: Compact encrypted communications device with minimal display.
props.narrativeSignificance: Allows contact with intelligence handlers and asset networks.
props.handlingNote: Used briefly and kept hidden from view.

props.name: Observation Camera
props.description: Miniature surveillance camera fitted inside an inconspicuous housing.

action.roleActions: Moves through the crowd while scanning faces and checking surveillance feeds for signs of the courier.
action.dialogue: One contact. One chance. No mistakes.
action.soundDesign: Marketplace chatter, footsteps, distant engines, subtle tension drone.

action.roleActions: Approaches the rooftop edge, periodically checking for followers before preparing for a covert meeting.
action.roleDialog: Measured caution mixed with underlying fear.
action.soundDesign: Wind noise, distant city ambience, faint electronic interference.

action.roleActions: Approaches carefully, exchanges brief eye contact, and discreetly passes the device before continuing onward.
action.soundDesign: Approaching train, station announcements, reverberant footsteps.

action.roleActions: Secures the intelligence, establishes contact with headquarters, and watches the departing train disappear into darkness.
action.dialogue: The information is secure. The operation continues.
action.soundDesign: Train departure, communication static, deep ambient score, fading station echoes.
